counts_policy: Original PR5148 charged once, three newer similarity inputs filtered before allocation charged once each, five fixed older inputs charged once each including source-filter rejects. Saved eligible inputs are not charged again merely when materialized; no repair/reset or additional independent source lineage is inferred.
biological_inputs: QCP regression uses synthetic coordinate arrays with unchanged upstream PDB fixture; other inputs are location/sequence utility regression cases. Fixture observation provenance still requires independent review.
selection_rationale: Prefer existing coordinate-alignment, molecular-weight and location-hash competencies; preserve filtered inputs and the remaining eligible source rather than silently replacing or resetting them.
